column1: # Ash Jenna's two fights: the optional super boss in Vale and the one at Suhalla Gate.

column3:
There you are, Isaac.
I wondered how long
you'd keep me waiting.{page_break}Vale still looks so
peaceful. It would
burn beautifully.{end_wait}
My mother lives here.\nYou won't touch her.{end_wait}
Then make me stop.\nI want to see your face\nwhen you fail her.{end_wait}
You won. How sweet.\nNow spend every night\nwondering when I'll return.{end_wait}

Look at these soldiers.
All that courage,
and none of it mattered.{page_break}I could finish them.
But watching you choose
who to save is better.{end_wait}
Get away from them.\nYour fight is with me.{end_wait}

Oh, Isaac. You still
think you get to
make the rules?{page_break}Then come closer.
Let's see how many
more I can break.{end_wait}

You beat me, Isaac.
But those men are
still bleeding.{page_break}Go on. Save them.
I'll remember how
easy you are to hurt.{end_wait}
